text:
lina_customer_acme: Hi team — after the update yesterday our product descriptions started dropping the price line and sometimes truncating promotional text. This started ~2026-03-16 22:10 UTC. Example attached in thread (sensitive data redacted).

sara_cs: sorry to hear that — can you paste one or two exact request bodies (with any PII removed) and the raw model response? request_id from the API response would be ideal.

lina_customer_acme: sure, here's one (removed customer IDs):
```json
{
  "model": "rdl-3b",
  "input": "Generate a short product blurb including name, price, and 2-line promo."
}
```
Response (raw):
```
Product: SuperWidget
Features: fast, durable
Promo: Limited-time deal — get 20% off
```
(we expected a separate `Price: $X` line between Product and Features)

sara_cs: thanks — can you also share the API response headers and the top of the invocation log (the `x-request-id` and `x-model-version` headers)? those help trace routing.

lina_customer_acme: headers: `x-request-id: rq_9f3b2a`, `x-model-version: rdl-3b:v20260315`

sara_cs: copying @matt_eng and @olivia_research for triage. we'll need prompt logs and a minimal repro. if you can run a quick curl that reproduces this, paste it here (redact tokens).

matt_eng: got it. can engineering confirm whether any postprocessing or regex-based extractors ran in the pipeline? last rollout note showed small tokenizer/normalization tweak. @dan_platform any automatic text normalization jobs applied to hosted responses in that window?

dan_platform: deploy-bot shows a small patch to whitespace normalization rolled out to hosted nodes at 2026-03-16T21:50:03Z — rollout id `roll_20260316_21_50`. It was toggled to 100% at 21:59 UTC. No other postprocess jobs were scheduled.

olivia_research: quick hypothesis: the normalization may be collapsing lines when `Price:` contains currency symbol + number, or the prompt parser's canonicalizer merged adjacent labeled lines. Can you try a minimal repro with an explicit `\nPrice:` token and `--no-normalize` flag (if available) and post both outputs?

lina_customer_acme: running now. curl (token redacted):
```bash
curl -sS https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n -H "Authorization: Bearer [REDACTED]" \n -d '{"model":"rdl-3b","input":"Product: TestWidget\nPrice: $49.99\nPromo: Two lines of promo here\nPlease output labeled fields."}'
```
Output: same missing Price line. request id `rq_9f3b2c`.

matt_eng: thanks. @olivia_research can you try the prompt locally against the pre-rollout model snapshot (v20260314) and the new model snapshot (v20260315) to confirm delta? I'll pull logs for `rq_9f3b2a` and `rq_9f3b2c`.

olivia_research: running quick local check now. initial results: v20260314 preserves the `Price:` line; v20260315 sometimes merges it into the previous line depending on tokenizer split. looks like a normalization/kern change in the serving runtime. I'll dump tokenization diffs.

sara_cs: Lina — appreciate the quick repro. We'll redact any sensitive bits and keep you updated. For visibility: if you can collect 3-5 failing examples and one passing example (if any), that speeds root cause. Also let us know if you're on Dedicated or Hosted.

lina_customer_acme: Hosted. attaching two more examples in a private link. thanks.

matt_eng: capturing this as ENG-TRIAGE-412. action items: (1) eng to collect tokenization diffs and runtime config for `roll_20260316_21_50`; (2) eng-ml to run bisect between model snapshots; (3) CS to get 3 failing + 1 passing repros from customer. I'll post logs here when available.

deploy-bot: Rollout roll_20260316_21_50: normalization-patch -> 100% applied on hosted pool at 2026-03-16T21:59:12Z (id rqctl_5541).

matt_eng: logs pulled for `rq_9f3b2a` and `rq_9f3b2c` and uploaded to internal storage (link redacted). early look: a `norm.collapse_adjacent_newlines` flag flipped true in runtime config for rollout id `roll_20260316_21_50`. Reverting that flag in a canary should be quick if we validate no regressions elsewhere.

olivia_research: I'll prepare a small tokenization test harness and post a gist with exact inputs -> token sequences for both snapshots. if we confirm it's the collapse flag, patching to respect labeled field boundaries should be possible.

sara_cs: noted. Lina we'll schedule a short joint screen-share to confirm fixes on your side once eng has a canary patch. thanks for the speedy repros — this is very helpful. :thumbsup:

lina_customer_acme: thanks everyone — looking forward to the update.
